verdict.rationale: Backup and restore is a fair axis for a search and indexing runtime, but the pack documents no user-initiated backup or restore of indexes. The only 'snapshot' mentioned is a local on-disk cache of a downloaded index, served when the cloud is unreachable. That is an adjacent resilience behavior, not a backup and restore capability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can back up collections with snapshots and restore them
